hypothesis: Range-conditioned BB reversals or higher-timeframe trend pullbacks may provide sufficient evening opportunities with positive cost-adjusted expectancy. Frequent signals without net profitability refute the goal.
baseline: Frozen Stage B reversal_close_next_open signals from bb_event_edge_20261003; replay with entry windows rather than filtering old fills.
data_clock_evidence: CONDITIONAL: data担当の同実験data_clock_evidence.json。実source timezone/DSTはUNKNOWN
higher_timeframe_rules: Only trend_reclaim uses source-clock H1. Each hour requires all12M5 starts at minute0,5,...55. Its close is known at hour_start+3600. At M5 signal i use only H1 end<=times[i]+300, never a current uncompleted H1. Use25consecutive complete H1 hours to calculate SMA20 now and exactly5hours earlier; absent hours break validity, no forward-fill. Original partially complete sourceM1 within M5 remains a known data limitation and is reported using existing masks.

entry_rules.baseline: Use immutable saved Stage B reversal candidates including their origin, side, index and tick-rounded signal-center target; original preparation/cancel/expiry rules unchanged. Saved BB origins begin source2020-01-01, so early assumed-JST2020 book hours shifted into source2019 lack baseline origins; do not label this as absent price coverage. FirstJan1 evening is later than this edge but no equivalence outside saved origins is claimed.
entry_rules.range_bb: Filter baseline by origin t prior12change direction efficiency: abs(close[t-1]-close[t-13])/sum(abs(diff(close[t-13:t]))))<=0.30. Exactly13prior closes excluding t; denominator0 yields0. Missing/nonfinite/visible gaps in those13bars reject. Entry and target otherwise baseline.
entry_rules.trend_reclaim: BUY when last completed valid H1 close>SMA20 and SMA20>SMA20 five hours earlier, prior M5 close<=prior SMA20, current closed M5 close>current SMA20. SELL mirrors strict direction and <=/> to >=/<. Require signal/prior M5 contiguous and finite. Signal is confirmed at times[i]+300. Store side and signal-known priorATR14*1.5 only; do not consult nextopen in signal generation.
entry_rules.execution: Next contiguous M5 open within period and applicable entry window. One position per symbol/arm. BB target=signal-time fixed center and minimum actual reward3pips; trend target=actual entryopen+side*(signal priorATR14*1.5), risk>=3pips, with mirror stop=2*entry-target. This target arithmetic occurs at execution boundary only. Signals on last period bar are pending/unfilled if nextcachebar exists; signals at cache terminal bar without nextopen are unfilled terminal_unpriced_signals counted separately, never invented fills. BB origin and signal must belong to same evaluation book. Signals may be prepared before19:00 but actual nextopen must be in window. Entry at19:00 is allowed; entry at00:00 is excluded. No daily trade quota/cap/forced orders.

exit_rules.description: Fixed symmetric brackets, next-open gaps at actual open, same-bar intrabar both-hit SL first. Exits permitted outside entry window and across nights. No midnight/time-stop exit. Each period starts flat; final open mark is separate from closed PF/win rate.

clock_semantics: Integer values are hypothetical source UTC offsets. assumed_JST=source_time+(9-offset)*3600. Fixed offsets throughout each year, no DST. gmt0 primary assumption; others sensitivity only, no best-clock selection. all_hours is a source-calendar period unrestricted-entry reference; its evening diagnostics use gmt0 labels and are not its all-day frequency.
period_calendar: For clock scenarios convert assumed-JST Jan1 boundary back to source using same offset. all_hours uses source Jan1. Only fully contained weekday nights appear in frequency denominator. No positions carried between books.
final_period_prior_exposure: All2020-2025 previously viewed. 2025 is descriptive confirmation, not virgin holdout. No later P/L used to modify thresholds or select clock.
search_space: range_bb and trend_reclaim only; baseline reference. Three periods x five clocks x three arms x two costs x seven pairs=630cases. Report all fixed cases even if training fails. No candidate selection: both candidates remain fixed, gates are reports only, all later results descriptive. No post-result tuning.
cost_and_fill_model: Hypothetical round-trip1.0pip and stress1.2pip. ChartOHLC, no observed GMO spread/slippage/swaps. Same trade path because fees do not affect signals/entry eligibility. Existing research_bb3_jev_engine.simulate reused unchanged.
position_sizing_and_currency: Fixed1R per trade, aggregate R and equal-pip research scores; no account currency sizing or leverage model.

frequency_rules.calendar: Every assumed-JST Monday-Friday date within period, including zero-entry nights. Weekend dates outside population. Each symbol needs all60M5 starts for19:00..23:55 to classify M5-observed complete; all7complete is primary denominator. Partial/missing nights counted separately, never silently treated as zero. Full-night future completeness is diagnostic censoring only and never an entry filter.
frequency_rules.source_m1: Existing complete_m5 masks produce supplemental count of nights where all7x60M5 contain all5M1 observations. Primary denominator remains M5-observed complete. Missing masks fail evidence preparation rather than invent completeness.
frequency_rules.metrics: Primary all-pair actual entries per complete night: mean, median, zero_pct, two_plus_pct, two_to_three_pct, above_three_pct. Report same metrics after exact entry-timestamp deduplication and number of duplicate entries. Report all-weekday totals and incomplete-night entries separately. Raw events/candidates are not fills. Screens use raw actual entries; dedup is mandatory limitation/operability diagnostic.
frequency_rules.midnight: Report entries whose position remains open after assumed midnight processing following its entry night. Closed trades' exit_time is stored candle start: exits on23:55candle are before midnight. On00:00candle, gap_stop/gap_target are known boundary exits, not carried; ordinary stop/target exits are intrabar boundary-uncertain. Strict carry excludes boundary-uncertain, possible carry includes it; known midnight gap exits reported separately. An open mark whose mark_time equals midnight only observes the previous23:55candle close, not midnight opening processing; it is right-censored. Require mark_time>midnight for strict open carry. Next-day exit rate uses assumed exit-candle calendar date among closed evening entries, with boundary limitation.

acceptance_gates.applies_to: gmt0 primary for new candidates; other clocks fixed sensitivity
acceptance_gates.over_three_mean: report over-target, do not select best3 trades after seeing outcomes
acceptance_gates.interpretation: Designer-set research screen, not proof of operations. Coverage gates added before P/L by main prereview. Unknown actual clock or unconfirmed night window forces adopted=false regardless of screen.

cross_symbol_rule: All7pairs pooled, each pair separately. Exact simultaneous M5 entries deduplicated only for opportunity report, not claimed independent risk. Combined close-MTM sums asynchronous individual books with last observation carried forward.
reporting: Pair/period and aggregate wins, PF_R/PF_pips, net/gross/costR, costpips, closed/open marks, closeMTMDD, entry counts, holding, nightcarry, calendar-year closed-trade exit attribution. Final-source and original input SHA preserved.
